Narrative section 1 recalls the prior Urbino commission and current section 2 begins 42476; sections 2–4 continue coherently 42491→42499 and 42544→42552. Current cross-reference note 42493–42494 remains. Full/short dating 42565–42569 and marginal section-4 synopsis 42575–42580 end before CXXIII 42583.
